source_text: Sitivit populus in Raphidim; percussa petra aqua fluxit. Petra autem erat Christus. Contumelia murmuris vapulat.
pass_a_gloss: Thirsted people in Rephidim; struck rock water flowed. Rock moreover was Christ. Insult of-murmur is-beaten.
pass_b_english: The people thirsted at Rephidim; the struck rock yielded water — [[and the Rock was Christ >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:4]]. Murmuring’s insult is chastened.
